environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on ECS Fargate in a public subnet with an internet-facing ALB. The service is accessible via public DNS (api.example.com). JWT_SECRET is set via environment variable. No additional request filtering or token validation middleware is deployed. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards all requests to the target group on port 3000.

config.alb_rules: Default action: forward to target group
